recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片可見一顆細長鐮刀細胞與數顆船形（boat-shaped）紅血球，並有多顆標靶細胞、三顆有核紅血球，許多紅血球內有細小深色的 Pappenheimer 小體，符合鐮刀型細胞/β0 地中海貧血並伴功能性脾臟低下。
features: Marked anisopoikilocytosis with target cells and boat-shaped (oat) cells
An elongated sickle cell with tapered ends
Three nucleated red blood cells with dense pyknotic nuclei
Many red cells containing small basophilic peripheral inclusions (Pappenheimer bodies)
Hypochromic/microcytic tendency with folded and irregularly contracted cells
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with numerous target cells, boat-shaped cells, folded cells, and an elongated sickle cell. Three nucleated red blood cells are present, and many red cells contain small, peripheral basophilic inclusions consistent with Pappenheimer bodies, reflecting hyposplenism. Platelets are adequate and no leukocyte abnormalities are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a sickling disorder with thalassemic features, supporting sickle cell/β0-thalassemia; hemoglobin analysis showing HbS without HbA and with increased HbA2 is needed for confirmation.

ddx.vs: HbSS usually has normocytic indices with fewer target cells, and it is separated from HbS/β0-thalassemia by microcytosis, increased HbA2, and family studies rather than by the smear alone.
HbSC shows angular SC poikilocytes and HbC crystals with abundant target cells, and electrophoresis shows HbC.
Basophilic stippling is fine and diffusely distributed throughout the cell, whereas Pappenheimer bodies are few coarse clustered granules at the periphery that stain with Prussian blue.
Howell-Jolly bodies are single, larger, round dense nuclear remnants rather than clusters of small iron-containing granules.
